% Files of the document named like a .4ht file, read with \input after
% \usepackage{glossaries}, with hyperref: one named like the glossaries
% package, and one like glossary.4ht. As in the PDF, each file's text is
% in the page, and the term links to its entry in the glossary.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{glossaries}
\input{glossaries.ltx}
\input{glossary.ltx}
\makenoidxglossaries
\newglossaryentry{ring}{name={ring},
  description={a set with two operations}}
\begin{document}
\section{Rings}
A \gls{ring}. \ownglossaries{} \ownglossary
\printnoidxglossaries
\end{document}
